objective: The check of a generated project fails when a document it verifies is missing, except in the nested copy of the render round trip.

criteria.text: A deleted CLAUDE.md or FRAMEWORK.md gives a FAIL line, outside the nested copy
The nested copy, which has only .claude, still passes

fails: a deleted document ends with All ok.; a regression
outOfScope: the other lines of the check
env: Node 24 and the standard library; the proof runs with node --test in a copy of this folder
output: the verdict of the critic on the issue
